design_parameters.enrich_notes: Ohio WQv uses P=0.75 in (WQv ac-ft = C × 0.75 × A / 12); Ohio EPA requires +20% WQv for sediment. Extended-detention drawdown varies by pond type (dry ED 48 h; wet ED 24 h; general WQv pond language 24–48 h). Infiltration trench: soil Ks 0.5–2.0 in/hr, WQv drain 24–48 h, ≥24 in clearance from SHWT to trench bottom. Bioretention: ≥40 h drawdown (Ohio EPA), 2.5 ft min planting soil, ponding generally <6 in up to 12 in, 4 ft min SHWT separation required (2 ft recommended). Wet permanent pool mean depth 3–6 ft; wetland pool depths often 6–18 in (avg 6–12 in). Sand filter design drawdown 40 h total.
